about: Rosenbaum Meier Personal Injury Lawyers is a New York City personal injury firm with offices in Manhattan, Brooklyn and the Bronx.

The firm states that consultations are free and that it works on a contingency fee basis, with no attorney's fees owed unless and until it recovers compensation. It publishes a 24-hour intake line and service in English and Spanish.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 3 listings, counts summed and rating weighted by count

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours, photo count and description come from the Places API. The services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way.

G1.evidence: 9 of 11 named attorneys are currently registered and none carries an adverse status. 2 could not be told apart from namesakes in the register and are counted neither way
G1.source: NYS Attorney Registrations (data.ny.gov eqw2-r5nb), published by the NYS Unified Court System

G2.evidence: None of the 9 named attorneys carries a disciplinary status on the public register: no disbarment, suspension or disciplinary resignation. Those statuses persist, so the check reaches back years, but it would not show a censure or a suspension since lifted.
G2.source: NYS Attorney Registrations (data.ny.gov eqw2-r5nb), published by the NYS Unified Court System. Current status, which is what this register carries

G3.evidence: No matching entity found in the active corporations register. New York does not require a general partnership to file with the Department of State, so this is not evidence against the firm, only a check we could not complete from this source
G3.source: Active Corporations register (data.ny.gov n9v6-gdp6), published by the New York State Department of State, partial
G3.unresolvable: New York does not require every law firm to file with the Department of State, so this register cannot answer for one that is not obliged to appear in it

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 11 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 259 public client reviews across 3 Google listings, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2006-07-27, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP

score.verdict: 4 of 5 eligibility gates passed. 1 could not be answered from the available records (G3) and does not count against the firm. Strongest pillar: B; most headroom in pillar E (7/15).
